ECONOVAS — Where Space Data Becomes Solutions for Earth. 🌎🚀

We are a multidisciplinary team from Huánuco, Peru, passionate about science, technology, and innovation. We believe in the power of creativity, knowledge, and teamwork to tackle global challenges. Driven by curiosity and a commitment to making a difference, we aim to prove that great ideas can emerge from our region, transcend borders, and create a positive impact on our planet.
